verdict.rationale: Nix is a CLI-only tool (nix build, nix run, nix-shell --run, remote builds, binary caches) that is inherently scriptable and used headlessly in CI per community reports (e.g., large-scale Nix CI/deployment usage), but there is no first-party documentation specifically addressing CI integration, headless/non-interactive flags, or official CI templates/actions. missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless documentation, official GitHub Actions or CI integration guide, non-interactive mode flags/examples.
